title: Azusawa Kohane — The "Legend" We Came To Know〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I'm practicing with Taiga then, so I'll head over to the park once we're done.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to learn as much as I can from him today.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (In order to surpass RAD WEEKEND!)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, what did you think of RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Think you can surpass it...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We will... We absolutely will!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I guess An already saw my reply.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I promise to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Not only that, I want to be able to teach everyone what I learn.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But what are we gonna do today?
It's always so hard to predict what he has in store for me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We'd be singing one day, listening to music and discussing lyrics the next...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But he'll leave me completely puzzled some days since I won't really know how to apply what we're doing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there was that one time I managed to figure out his little enigma.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, this place...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sorry, we'll be making a quick detour.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay, I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey! Anyone home?

rows.Speaker: Eatery Owner
rows.Line:
Well if it isn't Taiga!
It's great to see that you're really back!

rows.Speaker: Taiga's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah, I got back a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Taiga's Voice
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe you upped and moved to a better location. Your old place was gone, so I thought you'd gone out of business or something.

rows.Speaker: Eatery Owner
rows.Line: The live house next to my place also ended up moving, so I decided to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Eatery Owner
rows.Line:
But fear not.
My storefront may be new and shiny, but what I make is as good as ever.

rows.Speaker: Taiga's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean. Things might look different on the outside, but nothing's changed on the inside.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Nothing's changed on the inside...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Taiga's been examining all the places we've been visiting in Vivid Street to see whether or not they've changed, and how much if they have.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I guess it would be interesting to see how things change after being away for so long...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which leads me to believe that there's a hidden message behind everything we've been doing.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
Thanks for letting me take that detour.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?! I-I'm sorry...
I was just thinking about what you two were talking about...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The meaning behind what I've been doing with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For example, I've been noticing how you've been taking an interest in how things have changed around here over the years...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I see. Is that your interpretation...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. But I apologize if you think I'm getting the wrong idea.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. I'd say not quite, but you're on the right track.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. Want me to tell you a little secret about what we've been doing so far?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Ever hear this before? They say that about 80% of the information we take in comes from what we see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I think I've heard it on TV before...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You can learn a lot from just people-watching, looking around the city, seeing all the colors and gauging how close or far away certain things are.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But where does that leave our ears?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Our ears...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah.
What can we learn from hearing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We can... Hear how people feel...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly.
That also includes how far away they are and which way they're facing.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Still, our eyes still end up being more powerful than our ears. Which means there's only so much you can do with sound alone.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But we're here to sing.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So the question becomes, “How do you make people see through music?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: See through music...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah.
More than that depending on the situation.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The lyrics for a song don't always describe things that are grounded in reality. There are times when you have to imagine what's going on yourself.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And it's not just about showing people that. You can also make them remember things from their past...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll understand eventually.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, my point is that just singing isn't enough. I want you to at least take that away from this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still... Seeing through music...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Alright! This just means I need to keep practicing to figure out what he really means by that!
